patterns.comment: The body holds tiddler lines. Wikitext reads inside a value, never at line level, so an unmatched line cannot open a run that swallows the lines after it.

L:meta.variable.macro.body.tiddlywiki5.comment: Text replacement, which a define body takes and the other three definition bodies do not. A grammar wrapping another keys its injections on its own scope, so the wrapped grammar own never fire here. This format carries one line per tiddler and a pragma anchors on ^, so no definition body stands here — yet removing this block moves the colouring of an ordinary text field, by a route nobody has traced. It stays until somebody can say why.

3.name: meta.tiddle.field.text.tiddlywiki5.multids-file
3.comment: A tiddler text field, one line of it. A pragma anchors on ^ and this capture opens mid-line, so no definition stands here and no definition body follows.

titleline.comment: boot.js takes the first colon on the line: the title runs up to it and the text follows. A line with no value defines a tiddler with empty text.
